faq.q: What is the Shitzu Squalo in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a watercraft included as part of the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition. Rockstar's official screenshot archive contains four images specifically titled for the Shitzu Squalo, confirming the manufacturer and model name.

faq.q: How do you get the Shitzu Squalo?
faq.a: It is included with the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition. Rockstar has not described any separate purchase or unlock method.

faq.q: Is the GTA 6 Shitzu Squalo the same as the Squalo in GTA Online?
faq.a: Not confirmed as identical. A GTA Online vehicle shares the Squalo name, but Rockstar has not stated that the GTA VI version carries the same specifications, so GTA Online details are not applied to this entry.

faq.q: What speed can the Shitzu Squalo reach?
faq.a: Rockstar has not published final speed, handling or passenger capacity figures for the watercraft. Only its manufacturer, model name and edition inclusion are confirmed so far.

faq.q: How many official images of the Shitzu Squalo exist?
faq.a: Rockstar's official screenshot archive contains four images specifically titled for the Shitzu Squalo, making it one of the more visually documented Ultimate Edition vehicles.
